# archestra_model_provider (Resource)

API key for an LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). Models are auto-discovered after creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# --- Variables this file references ---
# Add to your variables.tf (set values via TF_VAR_<name> env vars or a
# gitignored terraform.tfvars):
#
#   variable "openai_api_key"                  { type = string, sensitive = true }
#   variable "anthropic_api_key_engineering"   { type = string, sensitive = true }
#   variable "azure_openai_key"                { type = string, sensitive = true }
#
# Also assumed declared elsewhere in your module: archestra_team.engineering.

# The plaintext key is sent to the backend
# on create and stored encrypted; pass via a TF variable so it never lands
# in version control.
resource "archestra_model_provider" "inline" {
  name         = "Production OpenAI Key"
  api_key      = var.openai_api_key
  llm_provider = "openai"
  is_primary   = true
}

# Additional provider key. Manage object access through direct grants.
resource "archestra_model_provider" "engineering_anthropic" {
  name         = "Engineering Anthropic Key"
  api_key      = var.anthropic_api_key_engineering
  llm_provider = "anthropic"
}

# Self-hosted Ollama via custom base URL.
# `api_key` can be any non-empty string; the backend doesn't use it for
# Ollama, but the wire schema requires the field.
resource "archestra_model_provider" "ollama_local" {
  name         = "Local Ollama"
  api_key      = "unused"
  llm_provider = "ollama"
  base_url     = "http://ollama.internal.acme.com:11434"
}

# Azure OpenAI. Set the deployment endpoint via base_url.
resource "archestra_model_provider" "azure_openai" {
  name         = "Azure OpenAI East-US"
  api_key      = var.azure_openai_key
  llm_provider = "azure"
  base_url     = "https://acme-openai-eastus.openai.azure.com/"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `llm_provider` (String) LLM provider for this API key
- `name` (String) Name of the API key

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key value.
- `aws_access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) AWS access key identifier for Bedrock SigV4 authentication.
- `aws_secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) AWS secret access key for Bedrock SigV4 authentication.
- `aws_session_token` (String, Sensitive) Optional AWS session token for temporary Bedrock credentials.
- `base_url` (String) Custom base URL for the LLM provider endpoint
- `extra_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Additional HTTP headers sent to the provider endpoint.
- `inference_base_url` (String) Runtime endpoint override, separate from the discovery base URL.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this API key is the primary key for the provider
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Labels assigned to the provider key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Additional direct sharing grants on this object. Applied atomically on creation and reconciled in place thereafter. Omit to preserve current grants; set [] to clear additional grants. The owner's existing grant is preserved automatically; inherited access and ownership remain managed by Archestra. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `shared` (Boolean) Create an organization-owned provider key; ownership changes require replacement and omission preserves existing ownership.

### Read-Only

- `created_by` (String) Creator identity metadata as JSON.
- `created_by_service_account_id` (String) Service account that created the key.
- `id` (String) LLM Provider API key identifier
- `is_agent_key` (Boolean) True for a platform-managed agent key, which rejects user edits.
- `requires_reauthentication` (Boolean) Whether the credential requires reauthentication.
- `scope` (String) Backend credential scope.
- `subscription_kind` (String) Subscription credential type, when applicable.
- `team_id` (String) Backend team association, when present.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_model_provider.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
